notablePrerequisites: Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.
